title: Conditional doubling step
statement: For a Boolean list $S$, define its next state to be the pair encoding of the list obtained by prefixing `false` to the first component of the default first-pair decomposition of $S$, together with the second component of that decomposition, if $S$ satisfies the predicate `lt`; otherwise, leave $S$ unchanged.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define `lt`, the pair encoding, or the default first-pair decomposition, so their mathematical meanings cannot be stated more explicitly.
